relations.text: Appleは、販売店や受託製造業者などを通じた購入で、純売上高の2025年度67%、2024年度69%、2023年度66%を占めた
relations.text_en: Apple, through sales to distributors, contract manufacturers and direct sales, accounted for 67%, 69% and 66% of net revenue in fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively

source.label: Skyworks Solutions 10-K
source.quote: During fiscal 2025, fiscal 2024, and fiscal 2023, Apple, through sales to multiple distributors, contract manufacturers, and direct sales for multiple applications including smartphones, tablets, desktop, and notebook computers, watches and other devices, in the aggregate accounted for 67 %, 69 %, and 66 % of the Company’s net revenue, respectively.

relations.text: AmazonとApple Inc.は、Skyworksの主要顧客に当たる
relations.text_en: Amazon and Apple Inc. are among Skyworks' key customers.

source.quote: Our key customers include Amazon, Apple Inc.

relations.text: Qorvoは、Skyworksとの合併契約(Agreement and Plan of Merger)に2025年10月27日付で合意した
relations.text_en: Qorvo entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Skyworks on October 27, 2025

source.label: Qorvo 10-K
source.quote: On October 27, 2025, we entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement”), by and among Skyworks Solutions, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Skyworks”), the Company, Comet Acquisition Corp., a Delaware corporation and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Skyworks (“Merger Sub
source.note: 合併は計画段階の記載です。

relations.text: Qorvoとの合併の行方が不透明なため、Skyworksは取引先との関係が損なわれるおそれがある
relations.text_en: Uncertainty about the outcome of the Mergers with Qorvo could disrupt Skyworks' business relationships.

source.label: Skyworks Solutions 10-K
source.quote: Uncertainty regarding the outcome of the Mergers and our future could disrupt our business relationships with our existing and potential customers, distributors, service providers and other business partners, who may attempt to negotiate changes in existing business relationships or consider entering into business relationships with parties other than Qorvo.

relations.text: QorvoはSkyworksの競合企業に挙がる

source.label: Skyworks Solutions 10-K
source.quote: Our competitors include Analog Devices, Broadcom, Cirrus Logic, Murata Manufacturing, NXP Semiconductors, Qorvo, Qualcomm, and Texas Instruments.

relations.text: Skyworksは、Silicon LaboratoriesのInfrastructure and Automotive事業の取得代金の一部に充てるため、2021年7月26日にタームローン10億ドルを借り入れた
relations.text_en: On July 26, 2021 Skyworks borrowed $1.0 billion of term loans to finance part of the purchase price for Silicon Laboratories' Infrastructure and Automotive business

source.label: Skyworks Solutions 10-K
source.quote: On July 26, 2021, the Company borrowed $ 1.0 billion in aggregate principal amount of term loans (the “Term Loans”) under the Term Loan Facility to finance a portion of the purchase price for the acquisition of the Infrastructure and Automotive business of Silicon Laboratories Inc. and to pay fees and expenses incurred in connection therewith.
source.note: 2021年の取得に関する記載です。

relations.text: Skyworksは2021年5月21日に、JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.を管理代理人とする750百万ドルのリボルビング・クレジット・ファシリティ契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On May 21, 2021 Skyworks entered into a revolving credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent, providing a $750 million revolving credit facility

source.quote: Additionally, on May 21, 2021, the Company entered into a revolving credit agreement with various financial institutions, as lenders, and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent, providing for a $750 million revolving credit facility (the “Revolving Credit Facility”).
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。
